query:
The group decided to do a Saturday pub quiz together. Who agreed, and was there anyone whose agreement carried a meaningfully different quality than the others'?

Options:
A. Ravi
B. Cleo
C. Bex
D. Tom
context:
[1] (about=Bex, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T11:10:00) I will. I think I'm going to make it a proper Saturday thing now that there's actually a kitchen worth using.
[2] (about=Cleo, core, t4 @2026-01-25T11:04:00) Cleo is not great at quizzes but will come and draw on the answer sheet.
[3] (about=Cleo, said_by=Nadia, profile, t6 @2026-02-01T11:11:00) Nadia notes Cleo got the entire arts and culture round at the pub quiz on her own.
[4] (about=Cleo, core, t6 @2026-02-01T11:11:00) Zine culture and printmaking came up at the pub quiz; it was a home round for her.
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t4 @2026-01-25T11:04:00) Group decides to do pub quiz next Saturday as a unit.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t4 @2026-01-25T11:04:00) Saturday night quiz, everyone in.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t14 @2026-03-01T11:07:00) Group formally agrees to keep the Sunday meetings going indefinitely; all four say yes.
[8] (about=Ravi, core, t6 @2026-02-01T11:11:00) Ravi admits he was wrong about the quiz format being incompatible with the full group; Cleo was useful.
[9] (about=Ravi, said_by=Tom, profile, t4 @2026-01-25T11:04:00) Tom says Ravi occasionally carries the quiz team.
[10] (about=Tom, episodic, t12 @2026-02-22T11:05:00) It requires analysis because four years is a long time to like a quiz.
agent_answer:
All four agreed to the Saturday pub quiz: Ravi, Cleo, Bex, and Tom — the group note says “everyone in.”

The agreement with a meaningfully different quality was **Bex**: she said, “I will. I think I’m going to make it a proper Saturday thing now that there’s actually a kitchen worth using,” meaning she wasn’t just agreeing to the quiz — she was turning it into a recurring Saturday ritual.
